This page describes a cleaned JA-MENTOR youth survey. It uses the same scoring as the local report: Likert sums are prorated when at least 80% of the items are answered, and ACE-IQ follows the World Health Organization category rules.

The workbook stays in this browser. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is stored on the server.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
loaded = false
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof workbook = {
  const input = Inputs.file({
    label: "Cleaned workbook (.xlsx)",
    accept: ".xlsx,.xls",
    multiple: false
  });
  input.id = "workbook-file";
  return input;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
workbook_name = {
  const chosen = workbook;
  const input = document.querySelector("#workbook-file");
  const file = input && input.files && input.files[0];
  return file ? file.name : (chosen && chosen.name) || "";
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
uploaded = {
  const chosen = workbook;
  const input = document.querySelector("#workbook-file");
  const file = input && input.files && input.files[0];
  if (!file) return false;
  const webR = await webROjs.webRPromise;
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
  await webR.FS.writeFile("upload.xlsx", bytes);
  if (window.XLSX) {
    const book = XLSX.read(bytes, { type: "array" });
    const sheetName = book.SheetNames.includes("Cleaned") ? "Cleaned" : book.SheetNames[0];
    const csv = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_csv(book.Sheets[sheetName]);
    await webR.FS.writeFile("upload.csv", new TextEncoder().encode(csv));
  }
  return true;
}
```

```{webr}
#| input:
#|   - uploaded
#|   - workbook_name
#| define: loaded
#| envir: global
options(mentor.webr = TRUE)
root <- "vfs/report/R"
for (file in c(
  "load_survey.R", "scores.R", "plots.R", "scales.R", "scale_page.R", "sections.R"
)) {
  source(file.path(root, file), local = FALSE)
}
if (!isTRUE(uploaded)) {
  loaded <- FALSE
  htmltools::browsable(htmltools::tags$p(
    "Choose a cleaned workbook. The report is built in this browser after the file is read."
  ))
} else {
  survey <- tryCatch(
    load_survey("upload.xlsx", report_dir = "vfs/report"),
    error = function(e) {
      if (!file.exists("upload.csv")) stop(conditionMessage(e))
      load_survey("upload.csv", report_dir = "vfs/report")
    }
  )
  if (is.character(workbook_name) && length(workbook_name) == 1 && nzchar(workbook_name)) {
    survey$file <- basename(workbook_name)
  }
  loaded <- TRUE
  htmltools::browsable(htmltools::tags$p(paste0(
    "Loaded ", survey$file, ". ", survey$n_file, " rows were read, and ",
    survey$n_declined, " people who did not agree to take part are excluded. ",
    "The charts use the remaining ", survey$n, " young people."
  )))
}
```
